g.text: Objective: drop a company that looks cheap for a reason, then decide whether it survives all three layers.

text.tspan: it is rejected by the rules
failed rules of every layer recorded
average revenue growth over the last 3 years > −5%
fewer, or growth undefined through a base ≤ 0: fails
operating margin change (last − first) ≥ −200 basis points
over up to the last 3 years (the last four margins)
sector weighted average cost of capital (WACC)
sector WACC missing: skipped (never after the coverage gate)
a skipped detector counts as failed
Sloan ratio = (net income − operating cash flow)
missing figure or total assets ≤ 0: fails
average diluted share count growth ≤ 5% a year
unless cash paid for acquisitions over the last 3 fiscal years
fewer than two counts, or a base ≤ 0
a survivor with its value, quality and growth inputs, or a rejected company with its failed rules
